content: Cloudflare R2 is S3 compatible via endpoint https://ACCOUNT_ID.r2.cloudflarestorage.com region auto with boto3. Single PUT under 100 MB and multipart for large files, parts 5 MiB minimum except last and up to 10000 parts. Incomplete multipart uploads are aborted automatically after 7 days by default. Always call abort_multipart_upload on failure to free part storage. Streaming bodies supported by PutObject and CreateMultipartUpload.
